events.summary: Thank you for playing during Next Fest. I watched the first videos and fixed what got in your way. Your demo.6 save carries over. Fixes from your playthroughs The training battle waits until you have spent each wave's points. Before you leave points unspent, the game asks first. Locked upgrades now name the rank they wait for, and gold dots mark tabs with something to buy. Unit cards list the upgrades you bought, and a lost assault offers an Upgrades button. events.title: The free demo is out now
events.summary: This time the towers shoot at you. Lairs & Lordships is a reverse tower defense: plan your monster horde wave by wave, break the human fortresses, then hold the land when the lords raid back. The free demo is live now: a short campaign across all seven fortresses. Download it from the store page. Tell me what you think The Feedback button in the demo opens the game's Steam discussions.
